occurrences.text: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
